report.speaker: Luna Lomonaco and Sabyasachi Mukherjee
report.title: Algebraic Correspondences and Schwarz Reflections: Where Rational Dynamics Meets Kleinian Groups
report.outline_title: 从 Schwarz 反射到群与有理映射的代数缝合
report.version_role: Official published joint ICM2026 report, Volume5, online2026-07-13; supplements pinned separately.
report.copyright: Copyright 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Verified in the official Information/Copyright block.
report.question: How can algebraic correspondences realize rational iteration and Kleinian group action on different invariant pieces, and how do Schwarz reflections turn topological boundary compatibility into analytic matings and parameter-space structures?
report.reading_scope: Sections 1-10 including the Sullivan dictionary table, Definitions 2.2 and 5.1, Theorems 2.1, 2.3-2.4, 5.2-5.7 and 7.1, all surrounding arguments and open directions, captions of Figures 1-7, references 1-90 and publication metadata. Figures themselves, official PDF layout and source TeX were not visually inspected.
report.coverage_status: 53 atomic pages, one continuous mathematical overview and one reference. Major official branches are retained; elementary constructions have explicit derivations, deep existence/rigidity/compactness theorems are cited with hypotheses.

proof_scope.3901: Proves that the second iterate is holomorphic and computes the odd-period second-return multiplier.
proof_scope.3902: Explains finite projections and proves the graph and generator-union examples by polynomial equations.
proof_scope.3903: Factors the diagonal divisor and counts remaining fibers; explains critical diagonal points.
proof_scope.3904: Complete factorization, branch discriminant, finite critical diagonal calculation and homogeneous inverse-coordinate computation at infinity.
proof_scope.3905: 定义，逐项核对 BLLM arXiv:2407.14780v1 定义3.4；无存在性或一般拉直证明。
proof_scope.3906: Defines only degree-two parabolic-like mappings, dividing arcs and the nonescaping set. Conjugacy and straightening are separately recorded in390X and391D.
proof_scope.3907: Analytic definition of an orientation-preserving W1,2_loc quasiconformal homeomorphism, weak complex derivatives, Beltrami coefficient and distortion. Derives the real-linear stretching ratio and explicitly computes h_t(z)=z+t*conj(z). No integrability theorem is proved.
proof_scope.3908: Complete critical, multiplier and sign-conjugacy computations; fixes the marked-basin convention at A=0.
proof_scope.3909: Complete disk automorphism, derivative and boundary multiplier calculations for all d.
proof_scope.3910: 给出集合阈值换算、尾分布估计与 Tonelli 积分的逐步证明。
proof_scope.3911: 引用等价定理；保留后临界有限、双曲与拓扑可缝合三个限制，不证明 David 手术。
proof_scope.3912: 引用存在性定理；明确盆、乘子、标记、次数和对应复合次序。
proof_scope.3913: 引用存在性定理；逐项给出原文的正反向、夹点、外部生成元条件。
proof_scope.3914: 定义轨形类；逐步计算尖点和锥点对次数公式的贡献及两个例子。
proof_scope.3915: 引用一般缝合定理，保留群类、次数和两种互择假设；仅解释 Bowen–Series 编码机制。
proof_scope.3916: 证明 η+(z)=1/z 的复方向和边界方向不同，并验证有理一致化下的边界对合公式；一般代数化引用。
proof_scope.3917: 引用两个乘积嵌入、Bers 切片预紧性和一维紧化同胚；明确范围与边界限制。
proof_scope.3918: 定义并直接验证 bar(z)^d 在0与无穷远的临界性、固定性及后临界有限性。
proof_scope.3919: 引用三类对象的双射与 David 等变同胚；保留平面嵌入、秩次数和各自等价关系。
proof_scope.390A: Computes matrices and generators; invokes existing Euclidean generation proof for SL2Z.
proof_scope.390B: Complete involution and local derivative calculation, excluding a=1.
proof_scope.390C: Defines Klein combination and limit sets only with fundamental-domain boundaries smooth at P=1 and transverse to the parabolic axis; specifies c_a and the a=7 real-axis convention. Existence of transverse domains and independence under those choices are cited to BLII Proposition3.8 and Remark3.1; no combination theorem proof claimed.
proof_scope.390D: States the exact modular mating theorem and branch directions; surgery remains cited.
proof_scope.390E: Cites the dynamical homeomorphism and proves the logical topological consequence; separates rational from polynomial model.
proof_scope.390F: Defines reflection-based quadrature domains and distinguishes global continuation from local reflection.
proof_scope.390G: Complete involution, fixed-circle and inside-outside calculations.
proof_scope.390H: Complete local construction and uniqueness using holomorphic flattening and the identity theorem.
proof_scope.390I: States the characterization with boundary hypotheses; proves the conjugation formula at regular boundary points.
proof_scope.390J: Complete regular-value fiber count giving degrees n-1 and n, with ramification counted by continuity.
proof_scope.390K: Defines partial iteration for a finite quadrature multi-domain with only finitely many cusp/double-point singularities and pairwise boundary contacts; proves invariance where defined. Openness of the full tiling set is cited.
proof_scope.390L: Complete injectivity on closed exterior, critical point and infinity checks.
proof_scope.390M: Computes all three cusps and the quadratic-cubic local parametrization.
proof_scope.390N: Defines branches, proves degree -d by counting images, and cites orbit equivalence and circle conjugacy.
proof_scope.390O: Proves equivariance, well-defined quotient map, and its signed boundary degree.
proof_scope.390P: States conformal mating with the correct exterior uniformization and distinguishes compact-set conformality from hybrid conjugacy.
proof_scope.390Q: Derives the forward lifted branch and its multiplicity using 390J. The global recovery of two internal pieces and group action is the cited mating construction, not a consequence of the local calculation alone.
proof_scope.390R: Proves cardioid injectivity, containing circle tangency and the critical orbit 0-infinity-0; mating theorem cited.
proof_scope.390S: Gives exact univalence assumption and reflection/lift formulas; straightening and connectedness criteria cited.
proof_scope.390T: Defines packing, plane contact graph, two-connectivity and outerplanarity; no duplicate general Kleinian definition.
proof_scope.390U: Computes superattracting degree at infinity; cites marked-space homeomorphism.
proof_scope.390V: 逐项陈述正式缝合定义；解释紧集共形共轭与正反向分支，不证明存在性。
proof_scope.390W: 定义；证明后临界有限蕴含几何有限，并给出吸引临界轨道的区别。
proof_scope.390Y: 引用定理；分别说明 David 手术与拼图刚性所承担的步骤，不提供其深层证明。
proof_scope.390Z: 精确定义及 David 可积性定理的局部表述；不证明退化 Beltrami 方程可积性。
proof_scope.391A: 引用几何有限连通 Julia 集及项链极限集的可去性；证明可去性向紧子集传递及 Möbius 不变性。
proof_scope.391B: 逐步拼接两侧共形映射，验证边界一致、全局同胚并应用可去性。
proof_scope.391C: 解释边界商与球面条件；证明交织边界作用使关系在动力学下保持。
proof_scope.391E: 按原文给出角点、夹点、边界相交与原像条件；不从这一一般定义推出无条件拉直定理。
proof_scope.391F: 区分所引双临界实现与同胚猜想；直接检查 Chebyshev 多项式的两个临界值。
proof_scope.391G: 引用基本域一致化与指定圆盘上的单射；明确单值性范围和绕a=1的单值化障碍。
proof_scope.391H: 引用存在性定理；按原论文引言明确群区域的轨道等价与 Blaschke 正向分支，不证明高亏格构造。
proof_scope.390X: Defines parabolic-like restrictions and the arc-preserving neighborhood homeomorphism; the conjugacy equation is imposed only on Omega'_A and the dividing arc, not the full neighborhood. Quasiconformal and hybrid conditions follow Definition3.3. Distinct from391E/3905 pinched polygon data.
proof_scope.391D: States degree-two parabolic straightening, existence for every parabolic-like map and uniqueness of the conformal conjugacy class when K_f is connected. Proof is cited, not supplied; parameter sign and marked-basin conventions are explained.

normalization_notes: Coordinates for J_a have fixed points1,a; the persistent point is1, corresponding to0 in the original BP coordinates.
B=1-A^2 identifies A and -A. A=0 requires one marked parabolic basin; its complement is closed.
Cov0 means removal of the identity component followed by residual algebraic closure, not deletion of every point on the diagonal.
Antiholomorphic odd periods use the second-return multiplier; eta-=1/bar(z), eta+=1/z.
Generic parabolic basin maps are not all conformally the special unicritical B_d model.
3905 is specialized pinched hybrid equivalence, using3609 for the standard notion; generic Böttcher, local connectivity, polynomial-like and renormalization pages are reused from36.
3906 defines parabolic-like maps;390X defines their arc-preserving restricted conjugacy;391D states straightening. Ordinary3609, pinched3905 and parabolic-like390X are not interchangeable.
390C limit sets use transverse fundamental domains, with the real-axis convention at a=7.390D/390E/391G use these canonical sets.
